data.legalName: Annapurna Sweets and Snacks Private Limited
data.summary: Annapurna Sweets & Snacks saw daily volume average ₹7,12,588 over the last 48 hours against a declared baseline of ₹42,584. Settlement was expected at ₹14,07,622 but only ₹7,82,842 arrived, leaving a gap of ₹6,24,780. The merchant profile declares a single Pune outlet with terminals T-01 and T-02 processing about ₹40,000 daily, whereas activity shifted to new terminal(s) T-09 in Jaipur. Additionally, 32 payments totaling ₹13,40,000 are flagged, 94.0% of volume came from T-09 between midnight and 6 am, and the top three payers comprised 94.0% of transactions. This is a recommendation for review, not a finding of fraud.
